TextView.android:text:
🔒 GluMotion reads from Health Connect only:
🚶 Steps - shown in Home and Health, and saved in your account so you (and a coach you accepted) can follow your activity.
❤ Heart rate - shown at the top of Home.

GluMotion never writes, changes or deletes your health data, and never shares it with anyone except a coach you accepted. You can turn the permissions off any time in Health Connect.
